C001.reason: Required reference: constructs sample from request['speed'] in mps, must convert to kph (multiply by 3.6) and use new field name speed_kph.

C002.reason: Returns entity fields; entity field is speed_kph after deserialization, observation key must be speed_kph, value is decoded float32 kph.

C003.reason: Required reference: speeding threshold changes from 30.0 mps to >108.0 kph; entity.speed_kph used after conversion.

rationale: Schema change renames speed_mps to speed_kph and changes unit from mps to kph. Request provides speed in mps, so producers must scale by 3.6 before serialization. Threshold for speeding becomes >108.0 kph. Observation key becomes speed_kph. Wire field 2 remains float32. Entity v1/v2 unchanged per spec.
assumptions: Protobuf float32 values serialize as-is; Python float multiplication produces double but protobuf encodes as 32-bit
The generated VehicleTelemetry class now has speed_kph field instead of speed_mps
The threshold 108.0 corresponds to 30 mps * 3.6 = 108 kph
